![Favolaschia calocera from New Zealand](hero.jpg)

Mycologist based in El Cerrito, California. I write open-source tools for DNA barcoding, phylogenetics, iNaturalist, Mushroom Observer and macro photography.

---

## Use it in your browser

- **[Dikarya](https://dikarya.us/tree)** - Build phylogenetic trees from iNaturalist or Mushroom Observer observations, GenBank accessions or your own FASTA sequences
- **[Herbarium label generator](https://labels.dikarya.us)** - Make herbarium labels from iNaturalist or Mushroom Observer observations

## Featured projects

- **[Dikarya-phylogenetic-tree-generator](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/Dikarya-phylogenetic-tree-generator)** - Phylogenetic tree builder that runs IQ-TREE, RAxML-NG or MrBayes ([website](https://dikarya.us))
- **[inat.label.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/inat.label.py)** - Command line herbarium label generator for iNaturalist and Mushroom Observer observations ([website](https://labels.dikarya.us))
- **[inat.finder.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/inat.finder.py)** - Find the right iNaturalist observation when you have a mistyped number
- **[faststack](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/faststack)** - Fast photo viewer with basic editing and uploading
- **[inat.nearbyobservations.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/inat.nearbyobservations.py)** - Browser extension that finds nearby iNaturalist observations in the same genus
- **[stackcopy](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/stackcopy)** - Photo import tool for Olympus cameras that handles in-camera focus stacking
- **[Observation-Workbench](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/Observation-Workbench)** - Desktop app for identifying, editing and syncing iNaturalist and Mushroom Observer observations

## DNA & phylogenetics

- **[fixfasta.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/fixfasta.py)** - Reverse complement backwards ITS sequences in FASTA files
- **[Treecraft](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/Treecraft)** - GUI program for building and editing phylogenetic trees, written in Python with PyQt6
- **[convert.treebase.nexus.to.fasta.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/convert.treebase.nexus.to.fasta.py)** - Convert TreeBASE NEXUS downloads to FASTA

## Photography & media

- **[findphotodates.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/findphotodates.py)** - List your photos and videos with the dates they were taken, using exiftool
- **[video-rename](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/video-rename)** - Rename video files based on where they were shot and their orientation
- **[photos_to_presentation](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/photos_to_presentation)** - Make a LibreOffice Impress or PowerPoint slideshow from a folder of photos

## Utilities

- **[honeypath](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/honeypath)** - Plants fake credential files and alerts you when malware reads them (Linux, WSL, macOS)
- **[Lost-Phone-Finder](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/Lost-Phone-Finder)** - Android app that finds a phone lost in the backcountry by its Bluetooth signal
- **[printfunction.sh](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/printfunction.sh)** - Print Python function definitions from the command line using AST parsing
- **[rmdup.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/rmdup.py)** - Removes duplicate files
- **[stock.crash.monitor.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/stock.crash.monitor.py)** - Alert you if a stock changes in price quickly or goes above/below a certain amount

## iNaturalist tools

- **[inat.visualizer.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/inat.visualizer.py)** - Graph the seasonal occurrence of any organism anywhere in the world from iNaturalist data
- **[inat.photodownloader.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/inat.photodownloader.py)** - Make a CSV of the original filenames of your iNaturalist photos, and optionally download them
- **[inat.orders.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/inat.orders.py)** - Summarize iNaturalist observations by order, and optionally by family
- **[motoinat.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/motoinat.py)** - Find the iNaturalist observation that matches a Mushroom Observer observation number
- **[inat-gb-name.pl](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/inat-gb-name.pl)** - Compares the name on a Genbank record to the current name on iNaturalist

## Other tools

- **[taxonomybot.py](https://github.com/AlanRockefeller/taxonomybot.py)** - PyWikiBot that adds References and Gallery sections to species pages on mycomap.org
